title: Consolidate TF modules: standardized GPU nodepool profiles, HSM-aware IAM, and state-lock migration
author: Devon Patel
description:
Motivation:
Consolidate several ad-hoc TF changes we've been carrying per-customer into a single, vetted set of Terraform modules for Private deployments. This PR standardizes GPU node-pool profiles (taints/labels/scheduling), adds HSM/KMS-aware IAM role bindings for cross-account key use, and introduces a safe tfstate migration and locking strategy for customers migrating from folder-per-cluster layouts to a per-VPC/state-namespace layout.

What changed (high level):
- New module: modules/gpu_profiles (profiles for gpu nodepools with presets for latency/cost/spot, nodeSelector, taints, kubelet args).
- IAM: modules/iam/hsm_roles.tf introduces IAM role templates that include conditional KMS/HSM permissions and cross-account role assumption shortcuts used by private deployments that require on-prem HSM or cloud KMS with restricted key policies.
- Networking: networking/vpc-integration.tf refactors peering/route propagation helper inputs so Private installer can pass existing VPC IDs without needless recreation.
- State: state/migrator/README.md + scripts/tfstate-migrate.py provide an opinionated migration CLI that snapshots, acquires locks, and performs key renames atomically (with retries).
- Examples: examples/private/cluster-gpu.tf updated to consume the gpu_profiles module and new iam module.
- Docs: docs/private/tfstate-guidance.md describes rollback plan and recommended retention/backup cadence.

Commits (summary):
- 3c4a8b2  add gpu_profiles module + example presets
- b7e9f1d  add hsm-aware iam role templates and unit tests for policy generation
- a2d5e6f  add tfstate migrator script, docs, and CI pipeline steps

Files changed (selected paths):
- terraform/modules/gpu_profiles/main.tf (+120 lines new)
- terraform/modules/gpu_profiles/variables.tf
- terraform/modules/iam/hsm_roles.tf (+85 lines new)
- terraform/modules/iam/README.md
- terraform/networking/vpc-integration.tf (refactor; simplified inputs)
- terraform/state/migrator/README.md
- terraform/state/migrator/scripts/tfstate-migrate.py (new helper script)
- examples/private/cluster-gpu.tf (consumes new modules)
- docs/private/tfstate-guidance.md

Key implementation notes:
- gpu_profiles exposes three presets: latency-optimized, cost-optimized, and balanced. Presets are small variable maps so downstream stacks can select or override specific knobs (taints, labels, maxPods, gpuType).
- IAM role templates are split into managed-policy generation and role trust/assume statements. When enable_hsm_integration=true the module emits an additional managed policy resource with only KMS/HSM decrypt/describe permissions scoped to provided key ARNs.
- To avoid accidental keypolicy drift we generate IAM policies with a deterministic name scheme (module path + hash) and a documented patch procedure in the README.
- The tfstate migrator intentionally performs a dry-run first and will require a manual confirmation flag to actually rotate keys or rewrite state. It uses state locking (backend lock/unlock RPCs) and creates a compact change-log file per run so we can trace rollbacks.

CI and test outcomes:
- Initially: terraform fmt and tflint failed on the new modules (missing variable docs and trailing whitespace).
- Fixed: ran fmt and updated lint rules; unit tests for policy generation added under test/iam_policy_test.go (go test -run TestPolicy).
- Integration plan: runs in CI with a terraform init/validate/plan against examples/private using remote backend mock. Status: PASS (plan succeeded on commit a2d5e6f after fixes).

Risk and rollout plan:
- Backwards compatibility: default values preserve existing behavior. Customers who previously referenced bespoke gpu-lists will continue to work; recommend migration to presets using a small mapping step.
- Migration risk: tfstate migration must be coordinated during maintenance window. The migrator has a --dry-run and --confirm flag; we require an operator to review the change-log before confirm.
- Rollback: the migrator writes a pre-change snapshot (state-backup/<timestamp>.tfstate) and a reverse mapping; to rollback, apply the reverse mapping and restore backup in the backend. See docs/private/tfstate-guidance.md.

Review conversation (selected threads):
- Alina Park (review): "Can you ensure the managed policy for HSM doesn't grant kms:CreateGrant by default? We should require an explicit opt-in flag for grant creation; also add a note about HSM vendor key policies."
- Devon (author): "Good catch — removed CreateGrant from the policy and added enable_kms_grants boolean. Updated README with vendor notes and linked support ticket SUP-402 for on-prem HSM onboarding."
- Marcus Chen (review): "tfstate-migrator script looks reasonable but can we add a flag to skip lock acquisition for testing?"
- Devon: "Added --no-lock for CI/test workflows; documented the security risk in the README. The default remains to acquire locks."
- Sofia Ruiz (approver): "Verified plan against example private cluster; approves subject to CI green and a short follow-up PR to wire the migrator into the private-installer orchestration flow."

CI status: pass

- Added standardized GPU nodepool module with latency/cost presets
- Introduced HSM-aware IAM role templates and a safer, opt-in migration path for KMS grants
- Added state migrator tool and operator guidance for moving tfstate to per-VPC namespaces
